effectContract.getWave: payload2=4,direction3,speed low byte4,5..11=0; reject an unadmitted speed instead of guessing default
effectContract.waveSpeed: SET stores40; GET low byte40. No speed argument admitted. Existing alternate Wave baselines require preserved direction, never guessed Rightward.
effectContract.confirmation: GET0 reads the same active bank consumed by rendering. It establishes software-selected state, not emitted pixels. Explicit operations cannot skip solely on equal readback because GET82 does not expose overlay flag. Fresh admission and stop-on-ambiguity apply to every submitted intermediate/destination.
effectContract.parameterKnowledge: Read full12 from bank0. Reject unknown modes/counts/trailing parameters. Mode8 exposes custom-frame selection but not RGB pixels. Static and colored Breathing are read-only provenance; no RGB/frame restoration is admitted for this family.
effectContract.setterTransport: Model-specific reviewed destinations:650/651/652 legacy03/0A;695/696/711 typed0F/02 selector0 LED5 only. All confirmation uses GET0. No new6 frame or color writes.
effectContract.savedBankWarning: Selector1 is SAVED configuration, not actual/active selection. A prior0FSET1 can early-return against saved state while custom output remains. Neither effect GET1 nor brightness GET1 may independently confirm active state.

brightness.meaning: Active-bank raw brightness; saved-bank equality may otherwise bypass active application.

effectContract.reviewedButUnadmitted0FSetter: 650/651/6520F setters are retained as negative evidence for saved-state and custom-overlay aliasing; writes use exact Synapse legacy setters.695/696/711 admit0FSET0 Off/randomBreathing/Wave only under the specific transition contract.
effectContract.offBridgeReason: 695/696/711 Off setter checks active effect0 before clearing overlay. When captured active mode is already Off, first select randomBreathing(whose setter clears overlay unconditionally), confirm it, then select Off and confirm; this is a concrete MCU contract, not a generic entry requirement.
